target: W08 / P7 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001: deterministic before/after measurement of the governed execution flow (cycle time, operator touches, supervisor relays, model calls, audit calls, review calls, repair loops, proof churn, stale-head rework, maintenance cost, safety regressions) and a relay-retirement recommendation table. Measurement is shell/local and model-free. BEFORE = the linear pre-v2 flow as evidenced by existing proof/ and task-packets/ artifacts on the base commit for a fixed sample of packets; AFTER = this MacroPacket's own W01..W07 evidence set supplied read-only under the return directory. Base is the A1-audited W01 head 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875. A benchmark may recommend retirement; it may not authorize it (RETIREMENT_AUTHORIZED=NO is a constant in the output).
invariants: MACRO section 10 W08 applies. IMPLEMENTER_ROUTE builds the harness; MEASUREMENT_ROUTE is shell/local with model=NONE: no model, MCP, network or GitHub call is made to compute any metric. Every metric is a deterministic function of files on disk named in the packet; two runs on the same inputs produce byte-identical output.

BEFORE sample is fixed by path list in S1 (existing proof directories on the base commit); AFTER inputs are the evidence files under the caller-supplied --after-dir (the MACRO return directory), which is read-only. If any named input is missing the metric is reported as UNKNOWN, never estimated.

Metrics are defined operationally: cycle_time = last minus first timestamp found in the artifact set (UNKNOWN if fewer than two); operator_touches = count of recorded operator decisions/gates; supervisor_relays = count of return packets to a supervisor; model_calls = count of recorded implementer + auditor + team-lead calls; audit_calls = count of independent audit runs; review_calls = count of review/CI review events; repair_loops = count of repair requests; proof_churn = number of distinct proof/freeze artifacts superseded; stale_head_rework = count of audits or proofs whose subject head differed from the final head; maintenance_cost = lines added across governance/schema/tooling paths; safety_regressions = count of invariants I01-I20 with a recorded violation (from audit records), else 0 with the evidence list. Each metric's extraction rule is documented beside its code.

Output is a single JSON report {schema_version: 'dopemux.governed_execution.benchmark.v1', baseline, post_change, deltas, retirement_candidates[{relay, safe, observable, reversible, measurably_useful, authority_preserving, recommendation}], retirement_authorized: false, authority: 'NONE', inputs_digest} plus a Markdown rendering; retirement_candidates may only list relays that are not operator/nondelegable gates (I15) and recommendation is RECOMMEND_RETIRE | KEEP | INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

Base commit exactly 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875 in worktree .worktrees/gec-v2-w08 branch feat/gec-v2-w08-benchmark-001. Write surface is exactly commit.allowlist. Forbidden: src/dopemux/governed_execution/__init__.py, tests/unit/governed_execution/__init__.py, every sibling prefix, schemas/**, .control-tower/**, pyproject.toml, tests/governance/**, proof/**.

No model audits by the implementer; DETERMINISTIC_MEASUREMENT_AUDIT=NOT_REQUIRED per MACRO section 11; a semantic review is required only if the report recommends retiring a meaningful safety/manual gate (then the team lead dispatches it). No push; no TO/ConPort/dope-memory/GitHub mutation; no placeholders; ASCII only; ruff clean; type hints; frozen dataclasses; one substantive attempt.
